data.gist: Post-traumatic OA was induced in the right knee by transecting the medial meniscotibial ligament (DMM), with all surgeries done by one investigator.
data.plain: Osteoarthritis was created using the standard DMM model: the knee joint was opened, the ligament anchoring the inner meniscus was cut so the meniscus could shift, and the joint was closed. One surgeon performed all operations to reduce variability.
